faq.about.availableA: hired.video is available worldwide via the web app at hired.video and through our Chrome extensions on the Chrome Web Store. The platform is primarily English today, with localization in progress.
faq.about.contactA: Email us at info@hired.video, open the live chat from the bottom-right of any page, or use the Contact form. We respond within 24 hours on business days and typically much faster.
faq.about.contactQ: How can I contact the team?
faq.about.foundedA: hired.video was founded by a team of engineers, recruiters, and designers who believed that traditional text resumes were an inefficient way to showcase human talent. We're based in North America and serve members globally.
faq.about.hiringA: Yes! We're always looking for people who care about reshaping how professionals showcase their talents. Check the Careers page for current open roles, and if nothing fits you today, feel free to reach out anyway.
faq.about.moneyA: We operate a freemium subscription model. Core career tools — building a resume, generating a video, tracking applications, joining the community — are free. Paid plans unlock unlimited AI generations, advanced analytics, team seats, and recruiter features. We don't sell user data, and we never will.
faq.about.privacyA: Your data is yours. All content you create is private by default. We're GDPR compliant, encrypt data at rest and in transit, and support full data export and deletion at any time. You can read the full details on our Privacy Policy page.
faq.about.privacyQ: How do you handle my data and privacy?
faq.about.whatA: hired.video is an AI-powered career platform that combines AI video resumes, AI resume building and scoring, job matching, interview practice, a career community feed, and sourcing tools for recruiters — all in one workspace. It replaces the patchwork of tools most people use to run their job search.
faq.home.atsA: Yes. Every resume built in hired.video exports to an ATS-friendly PDF, with clean structure that parses cleanly in Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo, and most other major ATS platforms. You can also export your resume as Word (.docx) or plain text.
faq.home.atsQ: Does hired.video work with ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems)?
faq.home.cameraA: No. You can paste any resume into our AI Studio and export a polished 60-second video with animated scenes, professional typography, and optional voiceover — no camera, microphone, or editing skills required. If you prefer to record yourself, we support that too.
faq.home.cameraQ: Do I need a camera to make a video resume?
faq.home.freeA: Yes. Creating an account, building resumes, generating one video resume, tracking applications, and using the community feed are all free forever. Paid plans unlock unlimited video resumes, advanced AI tools, analytics, and recruiter features.
faq.home.linkedinA: LinkedIn is a professional network. hired.video is a career workspace. We don't replace LinkedIn — we integrate with it via our Chrome extension. The difference: LinkedIn shows you who you know; hired.video helps you actually run your job search and build a standout video resume.
faq.home.linkedinQ: How is hired.video different from LinkedIn?
faq.home.privateA: Your resumes, applications, and videos are private to you by default. You explicitly choose what to share publicly and who can see each feed post. We're GDPR-compliant, we never sell your data, and you can export or delete everything at any time.
faq.home.startA: Click Get Started Free at the top of this page, create your account in under 30 seconds, and the onboarding will guide you through building your first resume or generating a video. Most users have a shareable video resume in under 5 minutes.
faq.home.whatA: hired.video is an AI-powered career platform that combines a video resume studio, an ATS-friendly resume builder, an AI job-matching engine, interview practice, and a career community feed. Think of it as the one tab you keep open during your entire job search.
faq.home.whoA: hired.video is built for three personas: job seekers who want to stand out and stay organized, recruiters who need a modern sourcing + screening workflow, and employers who want to hire faster with video-first applications. The dashboard adapts automatically to your role.
faq.pricing.annualA: Yes — the annual plan saves 20%. Instead of ${{monthly}}/month, you pay ${{yearly}}/year (about ${{perMonth}}/month).
faq.pricing.annualQ: Is there a discount for annual billing?
faq.pricing.cancelA: Absolutely. There are no contracts or cancellation fees. Cancel from your account settings at any time and you'll keep access through the end of your billing period. Your data stays safe and you can re-subscribe whenever you want.
faq.pricing.cancelQ: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.pricing.costA: hired.video is free to start with generous limits — AI resume scoring, one published video resume, and 50K AI tokens per month. The Pro plan is ${{monthly}}/month (or ${{yearly}}/year with a 20% annual discount) and includes 1M AI tokens/month, 1080p video export, voice cloning, brand kits, and unlimited published videos. You can cancel anytime.
faq.pricing.freeA: The free plan includes AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job-resume matching (5/month), 10 job applications/month, 50K AI tokens for tools like the resume optimizer and salary calculator, and access to the full tool suite. No credit card required.
faq.pricing.freeQ: What's included in the free plan?
faq.pricing.teamA: Yes — Pro supports multi-seat teams with per-seat pricing. Recruiters get access to AI candidate sourcing, match scoring, and a visual hiring pipeline. Contact us for volume discounts on 10+ seats.
faq.pricing.teamQ: Do you offer team or recruiter pricing?
faq.pricing.tokensA: AI tokens are the currency that powers all AI features — resume scoring, video script generation, job matching, and more. Free users get 50K tokens/month; Pro users get 1M tokens/month. If you need more, top-up token packs start at $3.99 for 500K tokens.
faq.pricing.tokensQ: What are AI tokens and how do they work?
faq.pricing.tryProA: Yes — all AI tools are available on the free tier with a monthly token budget. You can score resumes, generate video resumes, and use every tool to see the quality before upgrading. Pro unlocks higher limits, 1080p export, voice cloning, and brand kits.
faq.pricing.tryProQ: Can I try Pro features before committing?
faq.recruiters.boardsA: LinkedIn, Indeed, AngelList, Wellfound, Otta, BuiltIn, GitHub, Dribbble, Behance, plus most ATS career sites (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Taleo).
faq.recruiters.candidateAccountA: No. You can source and pipeline candidates without them ever creating an account. Candidates only sign up if they choose to record a video resume themselves.
faq.recruiters.costA: Solo recruiters start free. Pro is $9.95/month per seat with unlimited sourcing, video screening, and AI matching. Volume discounts available for agencies.
faq.recruiters.gdprA: Yes. We support data subject access, deletion, and export, with retention policies you can configure per pipeline.
faq.recruiters.importA: Yes. Bulk-import candidates from a CSV, your existing ATS, or via our API. Existing tags and notes are preserved.
faq.recruiters.importQ: Can I import my existing candidate database?
faq.recruiters.linkedinA: Yes. The extension captures candidate profiles from LinkedIn, Indeed, AngelList, and 20+ other boards. Profiles import into a job pipeline in one click.
faq.recruiters.linkedinQ: Does the Chrome extension work on LinkedIn?
faq.recruiters.matchingA: Match scores combine skills, experience, location, and resume text against the job description. Recruiters routinely see 80–95% relevance on the top results, but you can always tune the weighting.
faq.signIn.freeA: Yes. hired.video is free to start with AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching, and 50K AI tokens per month. The Pro plan ($9.95/mo) unlocks unlimited features.
faq.signIn.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-in via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, email/password, and passwordless magic links. All methods are free.
faq.signIn.methodsQ: What sign-in methods does hired.video support?
faq.signIn.resetA: Click 'Forgot your password?' on the login page, enter your email, and you'll receive a reset link. You can also use passwordless magic link sign-in as an alternative.
faq.signIn.resetQ: How do I reset my password?
faq.signUp.freeA: Yes. hired.video is completely free to start. You get AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching (5/month), 50K AI tokens/month, and access to all 10+ career tools. No credit card required.
faq.signUp.freeQ: Is hired.video free to sign up?
faq.signUp.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-up via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, or email/password. All methods are free and give you immediate access to the platform.
faq.signUp.planA: The free plan includes: 1 published AI video resume, ATS-friendly resume builder, Chrome extension for job tracking, AI tools (resume scorer, optimizer, salary calculator, and more), career dashboard, job matching, and unlimited networking. Pro ($9.95/mo) adds unlimited videos, voice cloning, 1080p export, and 1M AI tokens/month.
faq.signUp.planQ: What's included in the free plan?
faq.signUp.setupA: Under 2 minutes. Sign up with Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, or email, choose your role (Job Seeker, Recruiter, or Employer), and you're in. You can create your first AI video resume in 60 seconds.

messages.studio.q1.a: No. Our AI generates a polished animated video from your written resume — no camera, microphone, or editing skills required. If you'd rather record yourself, you can upload a selfie-style video and the Studio will cut it into your scenes.
messages.studio.q1.q: Do I need to record myself on camera?
messages.studio.q2.a: Most people finish their first video in about 60 seconds of wall-clock time. Paste your resume, pick a theme, and the AI handles the script, timing, and scene transitions. You can then edit anything you like before exporting.
messages.studio.q2.q: How long does it take to make a video resume?
messages.studio.q3.a: The AI writes a 4-scene script — hook, experience, achievements, and call-to-action — tailored to your role and target job. It also chooses typography, motion intensity, and scene timing. You can tweak any scene with plain-English instructions.
messages.studio.q3.q: What does the AI actually generate?
messages.studio.q4.a: Yes. Save your colors, logo, and font once in a Brand Kit and every new video automatically applies your brand identity. Great for recruiters, creators, and companies producing multiple videos.
messages.studio.q4.q: Can I use my own branding?
messages.studio.q5.a: One click publishes directly to YouTube, or you can export MP4 and share manually. We also generate a public link with an embed snippet you can drop into LinkedIn, personal websites, or email signatures. Our AI LinkedIn post generator writes the hook, caption, and hashtags for you.
messages.studio.q5.q: Where can I publish my video?
messages.studio.q6.a: Your first AI-generated video is free on every account. Paid plans unlock unlimited generations, premium themes, 1080p export without watermark, voice cloning, brand kits, and video analytics. See the pricing page for current tiers.
messages.studio.q7.a: Export as MP4 in 720p or 1080p. Minimal, moderate, and cinematic motion presets. 16:9 landscape and 9:16 vertical (for TikTok, Reels, and LinkedIn short-form) are both supported.
messages.studio.q7.q: What video formats and resolutions do you support?
messages.studio.q8.a: Yes — the Studio is designed for candidates, recruiters, and companies. Use it to create video resumes, video job ads, company promos, or recruiter personal-brand videos. Every use case uses the same AI engine with different templates.
messages.studio.q8.q: Can recruiters and companies use the Studio too?
